record.source: -1 atlases; 0..15 prior target; 64..79 immutable image slot; 80..95 external GPU texture slot

alpha: external GPU textures (kind 12, source 80..95) are sampled premultiplied with the exact same rounded-corner SDF mask, clip, fade, and group opacity as isolated layer composites, enabling frosted glass popovers over live 3D viewports without CAShapeLayer cutouts.
ownership: host registers live external GPU textures via ui_host_set_ext_texture(host, slot, tex) on Apple Metal (MTLTexture) and Linux/Windows Vulkan (VksImage); components/ never imports metaverse-engine/ or gamebuilder/.
